arguments.question: Assess ANET’s market behavior over 5, 21 and 63 completed trading sessions versus SPY and XLK using the dated price series, comparison/path panels and deterministic historical probability panel. Interpret trend, relative strength, drawdown/volatility and leadership-versus-rebound alternatives. Report conditional positive-forward-return frequencies with exact sample sizes, empirical return ranges and unconditional base rates for every horizon, explicitly warning that overlapping/dependent historical analogs are not calibrated forecasts. Required deliverable: sourced observations, near-term path risks, competing interpretations and concrete completed-close or human-review thesis-change conditions. Stop once all three horizons and both benchmarks are addressed; do not create subjective probabilities.
arguments.decision_impact: Provide the only permitted probability language for upcoming weeks/months and determine whether observed price behavior confirms, merely reflects, or contradicts the fundamental thesis.
